$comment: Single source of truth for which paths belong to Trellis rather than to your project. Read by the map generator, the linter configs in setup/, and the integrity check. Add to this rather than repeating the list anywhere else.
$note: trellis.json is listed because it is Trellis's own declaration format, even though its contents are yours. Your project's source, tests, docs/specs and docs/mockups are never framework-owned.
$lintNote: Trellis ships scripts in Python and bash. A project that adds a linter would otherwise fail its very first lint run on files it does not own and cannot reasonably be asked to fix. setup/ ships ready-made exclusion configs for common linters.
